lines.en: I have my first English class today!
lines.ko: 오늘 제 첫 영어 수업이 있어요!

lines.en: Wow, Grandma! Who is your teacher?
My teacher is a kind young woman.
Did you study English when you were young?
Yes, I studied it at school long ago.
Are you going to ask many questions?
Of course. I will ask one question every lesson.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 수업마다 질문을 하나씩 할 거예요.

lines.en: Don't worry about mistakes, Grandma.
That's right. A mistake helps me learn.
lines.ko: 맞아요. 실수가 배우는 데 도움이 돼요.

lines.en: Have a good class! Study hard.
Hello, Teacher. Did you check my test yesterday?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 선생님. 어제 제 시험 확인했어요?

lines.en: Yes. I checked it yesterday. Nine were correct!
lines.ko: 네. 어제 확인했어요. 아홉 개가 맞았어요!

lines.en: Really? So I made only one mistake?
Yes, only question five. Don't worry about it.
I studied every night last week.
I know. You are a very good student.
Will the next test be hard?
No. We will study for it together in class.
lines.ko: 아니요. 수업 시간에 함께 준비할 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you, Teacher. I will do my best.
Great. See you at the next lesson!
